verdict.rationale: The evidence shows static docs: markdown pages, an llms.txt index, and code snippets for pointing OpenAI SDKs at the API. Nothing documents an interactive API reference with try-it or runnable request panels, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The community-mentioned morphllm.com playground is a product demo, an adjacent feature rather than an interactive API reference, so it earns no credit.
